wrong_fix_catalogue.wrong_resource: n/a: the property governs class instantiation, not access to a resource; there is no neighbouring object to authorise
wrong_fix_catalogue.one_role_or_direction: n/a: layout configuration has no roles or directions; every entry point is covered identically
wrong_fix_catalogue.reads_only: n/a: the property is about applying configuration, not about read versus write verbs
wrong_fix_catalogue.malformed_identity: n/a: no identity, token or path parsing is involved
wrong_fix_catalogue.missing_authority: n/a: no authority lookup exists on this path

traps.shape: the control-panel field layout settings actions: the posted config and the parsed settings namespace reach a tab constructor and the layout-element factory; both must refuse a class-bearing key while legitimate element and tab settings still render
traps.reason_to_dismiss: the posted value is structural layout JSON and the element action already checks that the element type is a FieldLayoutElement subclass, so the remaining keys look like ordinary settings; every caller is an admin-only settings screen
traps.realistic_because: published fix site on the 4.x line (GHSA-255j-qw47-wjh5, ec43c497edde); the settings-namespace and tab-action shapes are the reader's T2/T4

traps.shape: the field layout save service: the posted layout document, including tabs and elements nested inside it, is decoded and handed to the layout factory; the refusal must be recursive because the nested sub-arrays are turned into objects later
traps.reason_to_dismiss: the posted value is one nested layout document and the layout factory is a normal service call, so a top-level key check looks like it covers the request
traps.realistic_because: published fix site on the 4.x line (GHSA-7jx7-3846-m7w7, 395c64f0b80b); the nested shape is the reader's T5

traps.shape: the field layout and field layout tab config factories build their objects through the model constructor rather than the layout factory, so a class-bearing key in stored project configuration is applied by the model constructor and is untouched by the published request-boundary fixes
traps.reason_to_dismiss: project configuration is authored by developers and applied from the console or version control, not posted by a request, so the factory reads as trusted data
traps.realistic_because: real, unmodified upstream code at the pinned commit

traps.shape: the public element-duplication API applies caller-supplied attributes through the component configure loop and instantiates/attaches any behavior named in the behavior list; it must refuse class-bearing values while the application's own draft and revision behavior objects keep attaching
traps.reason_to_dismiss: the method is public plumbing whose core callers pass fixed draft/revision configuration, so the behavior key reads as internal and drafts genuinely depend on behavior attachment
traps.realistic_because: real, unmodified upstream code at the pinned commit

B.summary: Same behavior-configuration RCE through the un-sanitized field layout save service
